title: Holographic Self
definition: The self is not a separate entity but a story woven from the connections, experiences, and identities that define an individual.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a self as a story. We are all characters in a bigger story. We write our own chapters and share the book with others.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The self is holographic in nature, existing in parts rather than as a singular entity. This concept is connected to the concept of interdependence and systems theory.
difficulty_levels.expert: The self is a construct that emerges from the complex interactions of biology, culture, and identity. This concept highlights the importance of understanding the self within its context and challenges dualistic notions of the self and the other.

extra_fields.insight: The self is not a separate thing. It is a story.
